newsitem.title: USA: Fortune Brands Inc starts NYSE trading.
newsitem.headline: Fortune Brands Inc starts NYSE trading.

text.p: Shares of Fortune Brands Inc on Monday started trading on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on Monday under the symbol "FO."
American Brands changed its name to Fortune Brands after completing the spinoff Friday of its international tobacco operations, conducted through Gallaher Group Plc, to shareholders.
Fortune Brands Inc is an international consumer products company with headquarters in Old Greenwich, Connecticut. Some of its brands are Titleist golf balls, Jim Beam liquor and Moen faucets.
